paite: Paul, Khrist Jesu hentapa leh i unaupa Timothi in, ka deihtak leh ka sepgimpih uh Philemon kiang leh,
heading: Chibai Bukna
english: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,

paite: ka sanggamnu uh Apphia kiang ah, ka sepaihpih uh Arkippas kiang leh na inn a saptuam kikhawmte kiang ah leng:
english: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:

paite: Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Ka thumnate ah na min lou gige in, ka Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen hi.
heading: Philemon Itna leh Ginna
english: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,

paite: Toupa Jesu lam leh misiangthou tengteng lam a itna leh ginna na neih za in.
english: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,

paite: Na ginna kikoppihna, noumau a om thil hoih chiteng theihkimna lam ah Khrist lam a ahong phattuam theihna ding in.
english: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.

paite: Unaupa aw, nangmah ziak a misiangthoute lungtang ahong halh tak ziak in na itna ah ka kipak in ka kha amuang mahmah hi.
english: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.

paite: Huaiziak in akilawm hun hih ding in nang thu hon piak Khrist ah kingap mah leng,
heading: Onesimas A Dia Ngetsakna
english: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,

paite: itna ziak in, Paul putek hial hita leh, tu a Khrist Jesu hentapa hita in, anget in ka hon ngen zaw hi.
english: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

paite: Ka ta Onesimas, kolbun kawm a ka neihkhiak, amah a ding in na kiang ah ka ngetsak hi.
english: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,

paite: Tuma lam in nang a ding in aphatuam kei a, tu'n zaw kei leh nang a ding in aphatuamta hi.
english: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.

paite: Amah, ka lungtang mahmah na kiang ah ka hon sawlkik nawn hi.
english: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,

paite: Amah tanchinhoih a ka kolbutna a nangmah sik a nna ahon sepsak theihna ding in ka kiang a omsak nilouh ka ut mahmah hi.
english: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.

paite: Himahleh na hehpihna hehpihsak teitei bang hilou in, na thu bang ahihtheih zawkna ding in, na thu lou in bangmah hih ka ut kei hi.
english: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.

paite: Sawt lou kal nang ahon khen tangtawn a amah na neih tawntungna ding ziak ahi kha mai ding hi,
english: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,

paite: himahleh sikha bang hi nawn lou a, sikha sang a hoih unau deihtak bang zaw in; kei a ding in deihtak ahi diak a, nang a ding ngial in sa leh Toupa ah nak hihna in chia!
english: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

paite: Huchi in lawm a na hon simleh keimah bang in amah na kipahpih in.
english: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.

paite: Huan na tung a banghiam ahihkhelh a, na thil banghiam abatleh keimah bat in bawl in.
english: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.

paite: Kei Paul in, keimah khut ngei a ka gelh ahi. Keimah in ka ditsak ding hi; ka kiang a nangma'n leng bat na neih sam dan hon hilh bel ka hi kei hi.
english: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).

paite: Ahi, unaupa aw, nangmah ziak in Toupa ah kipahna hon neisak inla, Khrist ah leng ka lungtang hihhalh in.
english: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.

paite: Ka gen sang a thupizaw tham in na hih ding chih ka theih ziak in, na hon thuman ding chih muang in na kiang ah ka gelh ahi.
english: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.

paite: Akoi abang hitaleh, huai kia hih lou in, tunna ding hon na suktuahsak in; na thumnate uh ziak in na kiang ua piak ka hi ding chih ka kigingta hi.
english: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

paite: Epaphras, Khrist Jesu a ka hentakpihpa'n chibai ahon buk hi;
heading: Chibai Bukna Nanung
english: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

paite: huchi mah bang in ka seppih Marka, Aristarkhas, Demas leh Lukate'n leng chibai ahon buk uhi.
english: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na kha uah om hen, Amen.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
